title: TrackForge signing key, format 1
description: keys/<fingerprint>.json: one published Ed25519 public key. Never edited after publication; its end of service comes from keys/rotations/. See keys.md.

public_key.description: The raw 32-byte public key, standard padded base64 (44 characters).

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte public key, lowercase hex.
